name: Ottawa Comiccon
blurb: A former Fan Expo HQ comic and pop-culture weekend in Ottawa that no longer appears among the brand's current shows.
notes: Inactive: the given URL https://fanexpohq.com/ottawacomiccon/ now redirects to the generic fanexpohq.com/home/ corporate page with no Ottawa content. Fan Expo HQ's own current events listing (fanexpohq.com/home/events/) names 15 active shows (FAN EXPO New Orleans, Portland, Vancouver, Cleveland, Toronto Comicon, Calgary Expo, MEGACON Orlando, Philadelphia, Dallas, Denver, Chicago, Canada, Edmonton Expo, Boston, Dallas FAN FESTIVAL) and Ottawa Comiccon is not among them, nor does a site search of fanexpohq.com turn up any Ottawa page. No official cancellation announcement was found, but the brand's own site no longer carries it, so it is recorded as inactive (last run status/year not confirmable from an official source) rather than guessing a 2026/2027 date. The Facebook page (last known live presence) is used as the url since the old fanexpohq.com link no longer points to the event. No guests researched since there is no current edition.
